The Authenticate Developer Hub
Welcome to the Authenticate developer hub. You'll find comprehensive guides and documentation to help you start working with Authenticate as quickly as possible, as well as support if you get stuck. Let's jump right in!
Search⌘K

Get Started
Before you start, visit authenticate.com to explore our solutions and pricing.
Curious about our products? Check out our knowledge base for detailed information and FAQs.
Sign Up
To begin, please sign up on our platform.
Once registered, make sure to sign the mutual agreement document to complete the process.
Add a Payment method
Next, add a payment method to your account and deposit a minimum of $100.
As a bonus, you'll receive $20 in promotional credits to get you started.
Create a User
Ready to get started with user verification?
Let's create a new user using our APIs.
It's easy, fast, and secure. Simply follow the API documentation to seamlessly integrate user verification into your system.
Get Medallion™ JWT
Get the Medallion™ JWT and let your users complete their verifications hassle-free in under 3 minutes!
Say goodbye to cumbersome processes and hello to a stress-free experience. Our solution ensures a smooth and efficient verification process, making it easier than ever for your users.
Get Results and Analyze
Admins can review verification results and conduct further checks if needed to ensure maximum safety and security.
Our platform provides comprehensive tools for administrators to monitor and manage verification outcomes, allowing for additional scrutiny when necessary to maintain the highest standards of safety and security.
Set up Webhooks
Our seamless integration ensures that you never miss an update again. Set it up once and receive real-time alerts and notifications about important events, keeping you informed and ready to act.
Whether it's a critical system update, a user action, or any other significant event, our notifications will help you stay on top of things and maintain smooth operations. Learn more on webhooks here.
Set up ReAuthenticate™
You can now make re-KYC of your users easier and quicker. With ReAuthenticate™, all it takes is just a selfie! The best part is that it plugs right into Medallion. Experience the convenience and efficiency of our seamless integration.
Try it and see how it can save you time and hassle! For more information, check out our detailed ReAuthenticate™ documentation.
Mock APIs
Authenticate offers promotional credits to customers who deposit money into a new account.
To best understand the flow of the product, it’s recommended to leverage Mock APIs.
However, it’s important to keep in mind that real-time identity verification and document capture cannot be mocked.
